proposal.reason: Main substantive change is to open-source test workflow execution: dual-platform (M890P and OAM-810E) case generation/grouping, hardware matrix/rack placement, optional HPN SDK installation, expanded native-unit coverage, and reconciliation/report metadata updates. Other edits (workflow scripts, xtest generators, test lists including the patch-omitted postsil_unit_test_shm.json, and docs/tests) all support CI behavior rather than changing PCCL runtime modules or contribution/review policy.
